title: Keto Kissed Pudding Rice Bowl
description: A low-carb, keto-friendly dessert bowl featuring garlicky kissed pudding on a bed of rice.

ingredients.name: Rice (cauliflower)
ingredients.notes: Substitute with cauliflower rice for a low-carb option

ingredients.name: Kissed Pudding
ingredients.notes: Garlicky kissed pudding made with almond milk and sweetened with stevia

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince garlic and mix into kissed pudding for added flavor

ingredients.name: Vietnamese Cinnamon
ingredients.notes: Add a warm, sweet flavor with this aromatic spice

ingredients.name: Almond Milk
ingredients.notes: Low-carb milk alternative for the pudding

ingredients.name: Stevia
ingredients.notes: Natural sweetener used to sweeten the pudding

instructions: Rinse the cauliflower rice in a fine mesh strainer under cold water.

In a medium saucepan, combine the cauliflower rice, almond milk, and Vietnamese cinnamon. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the cauliflower is tender and the mixture is heated through.
In a separate saucepan, whisk together the kissed pudding and garlic. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until the pudding is heated through.
To assemble the bowls, divide the cooked cauliflower rice between two bowls.
Top each bowl with a scoop of the kissed pudding.
